formative_findings.finding: All local calls returned HTTP 200; native usage was below the declared measured allowance, with zero reported reasoning; no trial ended on input/output/time capacity.
Original eight trials: seven wrapper failures and one missing terminal report. No accepted final candidate.
Clarified Qwen produced 60 dispatched actions before four rejected terminal reports. Notebook was empty on 48 of those 60 actions; repeated listing/reading and incomplete relevant evidence persisted.
Clarified Gemma terminal replies had an extra closing brace; strict decoding preserved all four failures.

Rejected Qwen HTTPX advice missed the TestClient/version-binding and path-filter coverage obligations. GlyphsLib agent missed the explicit dev pin; fixed output saw a partial historical CI page but did not verify requirements-to-test flow or upstream release changes.

The interface, literal-search behavior and model-written notebook are plausible contributors. The host also omits the immediately preceding action and list/search scope from some next-turn observations; private trace provenance exists but is not supplied to the model. These observations do not isolate internal model causes or inherent agency capability.

retention: Raw corpus, prompts, replies, actions, provider frames and traces remain ignored local .tmp artifacts; this file publishes hashes, aggregates and bounded reviewer diagnoses only
